body.x: Institutes that leads development of up-to-date ICT Convergence Industry like Daegu Techno Park Mobile Convergence Center, Daegu Techno Park Sports Complex Industrial Support Center, Smart Venture Business School and Smart Drone Technology Center will participate in CES 2017 (Consumer Technology Show), the world's largest IT appliance exhibition in Las Vegas, USA, from January 5th to 8th with 22 prospective companies in Korea.CES 2017 is one of the world's major exhibitions where global companies are participating, as it marks the 50th anniversary of this year and is used as an important showcase in the launch of new products by IT companies around the world. The American Consumer Technology Association (CTA), which hosts the CES, predicted that more than 4,000 companies in 150 countries, 50,000 professionals, and 170,000 visitors will find the CES 2017.The Daegu Joint Pavilion is composed of 22 promising small / mid-sized companies and venture companies nationwide, and the participating companies are engaged with various fields such as IoT, AR / VR, robots, drones, sports convergence. And they will actively engage in marketing activities for overseas buyers, mainly in the North American market with the implemented products.The Daegu Joint Pavilion locates at Westgate Las Vegas (former LVH) and Sands Expo. Participating companies include Falcon, RF, Network Korea, Samjjeomilsa, IT Health, Griffon Dynamics, Nanorex, AR Mediaworks, NDS Solution, Elivision, Taewon Innovation, Hwashin, Seyoung Information Communication, SKIATE, Osung ENC, Quantum Games, Goqual Co.,Ltd, Aworks, Second Ground, Creators, Drogen and RGBLAB.On the other hand, Daegu Techno Park, Kyungpook National University Smart Venture Business School and Kyungpook National University Smart Drone Technology Center opened the CES Daegu Joint Pavilion and support the exhibition management and business buyer consultation of 22 companies.CES, which is the world's largest IT exhibition, is an annual showcase that can see the flow of the global home electronics industry, is held every January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). The global news network, which reported the most issues of CES, MWC and IFA, the world's top three tech exhibitions over the past decade, has sent a special report team to CES this year to report major issues in the global market, Introduction.
